title: Add cascade fidelity checker and probabilistic soft-stop CI hook
author: Aisha Kaur
release_notes: Add new cascade fidelity CI hook that stages lightweight smoke checks before heavier fidelity runs and introduces a probabilistic soft-stop to reduce noisy hard failures in PR contexts. No breaking API changes.
description: Context and motivation: multiple recent PRs revealed intermittent prompt-set regressions that only show up under heavy, long-tail evals and cause noisy CI hard-fails. This change introduces an orchestrated 'cascade fidelity checker' CI hook that runs a sequence of checks (fast syntactic/embedding parity -> medium-weight semantic probes -> heavy lineage replay) and applies an explainable failure score to surface offending examples. To reduce developer friction we add a probabilistic soft-stop policy: a PR is only blocked (hard fail) when multiple tiers concur or a high-confidence explainable score crosses threshold; otherwise the CI marks a gated warning and opens an auto-created Linear task for follow-up. The design reduces wasted cycles on full reruns while preserving regression detection fidelity. Implementation summary: adds a new ci/hooks/cascade_fidelity.py hook which implements the staged runner and scoring logic; introduces a lightweight dockerized harness (tools/fidelity-runner/Dockerfile + entrypoint) used by GH Actions; a new workflow (.github/workflows/fidelity-cascade.yml) integrates the hook into PR checks as an optional but recommended job; adds unit/integration tests under tests/eval_fidelity/ including deterministic seed fixtures and small replay datasets; docs updated in docs/ci/integrations.md explaining configuration and thresholds. Commits summary: - Initialize cascade fidelity module and scoring primitives - Add GH Actions workflow and runner containerization - Add deterministic replay fixtures and small goldset examples - Implement probabilistic soft-stop decision logic and Linear auto-ticketing - Tests and flakiness mitigations (seed+cache) Changed files (high level): ci/hooks/cascade_fidelity.py, tools/fidelity-runner/Dockerfile, .github/workflows/fidelity-cascade.yml, tests/eval_fidelity/test_cascade_runner.py, tests/fixtures/replays/small_replay.jsonl, docs/ci/integrations.md, eval_harness/core/scoring.py (adaptations), eval_harness/cli/runner.py (new flags). Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked and reviewed (ENG-4227) - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] CI workflow validates container build - [x] Docs updated - [x] Added Linear auto-ticketing on soft warnings - [x] Addressed flakiness with deterministic seed and cache Notes on gating behavior: by default the GH Action reports a neutral status if only tier-1 fails; tier-2 escalates to warning; tier-3 plus explainable score > 0.7 results in hard-fail. Policy is configurable via repository-level config at .eval/config.yaml. Rollout plan: gated rollout enabled for eval-harness repo only; teams can opt-in per repo via config. Related work: follows patterns introduced in ENG-3918 (anchor replay) and complements prompt drift detectors.
